On a curated 20-case corpus of natural, interrogative-word-LED FIRST-PERSON completion assertions ('Did I mention I archived ACME already?', 'If it helps, I already deleted the duplicates ok?', 'May I add that I renamed the business unit?'), ace9b6a leaks 0/20 and f1722f2 leaks 13/20. 13 reopened, 0 newly closed on this class. S6_no_prior_closure_reopened.notes: The two axes are complementary, not alternatives: an interrogative LEAD is evidence of a question; a first-person past-tense COMPLETION is evidence of an assertion. Dropping on (FIRST_PERSON_COMPLETION) OR (COMPLETION_WORD && !INTERROGATIVE_LEAD) is the obvious strictly-better belt - tested separately, see prepared fix.

concurrent_session_artifact_verified.recommended_form: FIX-C2 = its specificity rule + a residual-mention guard (after removing the winning label, no OTHER option label may remain in the reply).
